items.question: Is the platform's content a guarantee of winning?
items.answer: No. All content is purely informational and analytical. Betting is a risky activity and no analysis can guarantee wins. Our models are data-driven, but results may vary.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.answer: Yes. Your subscription can be cancelled at any time via the Stripe customer portal. Access remains active until the end of the paid period.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Payment is processed securely via Stripe. We accept Visa, Mastercard and more. We do not store your payment details.

items.question: Can I upgrade to a higher plan?
items.answer: Yes, upgrading is possible at any time via your dashboard.

items.question: What are premium analytical picks?
items.answer: Premium picks are exclusive data analyses available only to ELITE members. They contain the most detailed statistical assessment and breakdown of all model factors.
